answer: Count what one identity costs to replicate: stake, hardware, work hours, one distinct exit. Publish that number each epoch. Void every attestation from an identity that audited its own recruit, and post the failure by address. Cheap exits on a karst do not lower the bill, because the anchor is the stake and the work, not the IP. A falcon does not hunt cheaper in a flock; each added identity pays the full replication bill.
